anomalies.observed: The environmental-sensor header H5 (JST_PH, intended for the BME280) has its pin 1 tied to the +5V rail.
anomalies.expected: The spec states H5/H6 break out +3V3, and the BME280 is a 3.3 V sensor; H5 pin 1 should be on +3V3.

evidence.quote: Environmental Sensor (optional): H5 JST_PH pin 1 connected to +5V
H5, H6 (4-pin JST-PH headers) — each breaks out +3V3, GND, I2C_SCL, I2C_SDA.

anomalies.impact: A 3.3 V BME280 module connected to H5 would be over-volted and may be damaged; its I2C pull-ups could also pull the main bus to 5 V.

anomalies.observed: The high-side reverse-polarity protection MOSFET T7 is drawn as an AON6407, which the spec identifies as an N-channel MOSFET.
anomalies.expected: High-side reverse-polarity protection in this series arrangement requires a P-channel MOSFET; an N-channel AON6407 will not turn on properly and may only conduct through its body diode.

evidence.quote: T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch

anomalies.impact: The board may not power up correctly, or may operate with a large body-diode drop and excessive heating in the input path.

anomalies.observed: The Water Height Sensor block contains a LiDAR connector/part (PR4, H4 PB_1.25mm) wired to the main I2C nets NET0027/NET0031.
anomalies.expected: The spec says the TF-Luna LiDAR is unwired and its pins are free; water-level sensing is intended to be an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor on ESP32 GPIOs, not an I2C LiDAR connection.

evidence.quote: Water Height Sensor: PR4 LiDAR, H4 PB_1.25mm, pins connected to NET0027/NET0031
TF-Luna LiDAR module (PR1) is present ... its pins are 'free' ... it is not wired into any net.
The water-level sensing that is actually wired and actually used by firmware is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor read on two ESP32 GPIOs.

anomalies.impact: The board exposes an unintended I2C LiDAR interface instead of the intended GPIO ultrasonic interface, so the water-level sensing path no longer matches the specified design.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains three design deviations: the BME280 header H5 is powered from +5V instead of +3V3, the input reverse-polarity MOSFET T7 is an N-channel AON6407 where a P-channel device is needed, and a LiDAR is wired to the main I2C bus despite the specified water-level interface being an unwired TF-Luna plus an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor.

- Address 3: MS1=1, MS2=1.

- Address 3: MS1=1, MS2=1.
